rites.name: Tarnudoron
rites.text: Tarnudoron is the concept of the first sounding of Venilleth, the note that condensed the roots of the world out of an undated silence. It is less a being than a resonance that persists in the bedrock and is heard only by those who listen for it.

rites.name: Rostaunes
rites.text: Rostaunes is the concept of the first root-tone that gathered the scattered seeds of Venilleth into a single listening grove during the Singing. It was not a being but a resonance that taught the early sovereigns how growth could be called and held in place.

rites.name: Credar
rites.text: Credar is the concept of the sounding that condenses the first roots of Venilleth, a note held so long that matter learns to hold its shape. Within the Holy Age's temples it is kept as a rule of flame and order, mirrored in the orders that tend the sounding's echoes.

rites.name: Halarde
rites.text: Halarde is the concept of the Gate-Ward, the principle by which the doors between worlds are kept closed and opened only by sworn consent. In the Courts it is invoked during divine trials and councils, where its authority can seal a threshold or hold a rift shut. It is less a being than a rule that the Courts of Venilleth have agreed to obey.

rites.name: Oriemeiniel
rites.text: Oriemeiniel is the concept of a bridging threshold, the quiet understanding that a door between two worlds must hold both sides at once. In the Courts of Venilleth, it was invoked during the Age of Sundering to keep the old bonds from collapsing when landfall split communities apart.

rites.name: Elenneth
rites.text: Elenneth is a lattice-warden of Venilleth's Arcane realm, a keeper of the hidden hum that binds the smallest particles of all things. Her craft lets her coax matter to slip through barriers it should never cross, and she is known for guiding young apprentices through the uncertain stillness before a working. Her reputation rests on quiet precision rather than spectacle.

rites.name: Orielinna
rites.text: Orielinna is a concept of rank bestowed by the Veil of Thrane, a lattice of silver threads that recognizes anyone who has bound a wound in the field. Soldiers of every banner recognize her standing and yield to her in the infirmary, and gates open at her approach. She can coax bandages, splints, and tinctures from whatever the land provides, reed fiber, bark resin, or salt-crusted cloth.

rites.name: Silenora
rites.text: Silenora is a veiled concept in Venilleth's Arcane realm, a mutable blight that reshapes the bearer's face and the feelings of everyone who meets them. Some strangers answer with open hands and whispered routes to healers, while others bar their thresholds in terror of contagion. Its strongest manifestation is a wave of dread that can silence an entire district's hearths in a single night.

rites.name: Ryarlemwen
rites.text: Ryarlemwen is a wandering savant of the Arcane realm of Venilleth, known in every workshop from the glassblowers' terraces to the clockwork foundries for an uncanny grasp of engineering lore. Engineers' settlements open their hearths and tool-rooms to Ryarlemwen as a matter of custom, and any broken machine brought before them is diagnosed and mended from scavenged parts. The character's power is knowledge and access rather than raw force.

rites.name: Miannae
rites.text: Miannae is a concept of the Arcane realm in the world of Venilleth, a refuge-making power that lets its bearer find hidden shelters among the banished and the quietly sympathetic. It shields those who take it up from pursuers, though kin of the bearer's homeland grow reluctant to stand beside them when danger rises.

rites.name: Mialora
rites.text: Mialora is a concept in the arcane realm of Venilleth, an office of watchful wardens whose standing is honoured across every order sworn to the same vigil. The bearer's mark is read by any warden on sight, opening quiet doors and lending simple gear, so long as the bearer has never shown intent to harm the vigil.

rites.name: Ilyela
rites.text: Ilyela is a heresy, a doctrine that the lesser choirs of Venilleth have been feeding the gods' sleeping flames with their own prayers. Ilyela's teachings hold that the gods were once mortal and can be unmade by the same rites that made them. The concept has spread quietly among cloister scholars and threatens the entire hierarchy of the Arcane realm.

rites.name: Ryeriel
rites.text: Ryeriel is a Venilleth occult-scene fixer, a concept rather than a combatant, whose quiet influence opens doors to haunted sites and sealed ritual grounds. Known for their ear for dissident cults and forgotten orders, they read the faint signs of the uncanny that others walk past. Clients who hire them for hunts against foul things tend to treat them with unusual deference.

rites.name: Elanuamora
rites.text: Elanuamora is a concept-kind presence in the Arcane realm of Venilleth, an entity whose mere arrival draws the gaze of strangers and fellow travelers alike. Through this magnetic regard she opens doors to guilds, courts, and sealed archives that would otherwise stay shut to her companions.

rites.name: Nuinaellora
rites.text: Nuinaellora is a sense-weaving concept in Venilleth's Arcane realm, a faint resonance that lets its bearer feel the mood of the crowd and trace the hushed, scattered circles of dissent hidden inside a city. Its reach is modest in energy, mostly a matter of attunement rather than force, yet in the seventh age it has made it the quiet instrument of uprisings.

rites.name: Eleimys
rites.text: Eleimys is a wandering seer of the Venilleth Arcane realm, whose eyes slip between the living road and the thin veils where spirits linger. Locals greet them at every hearth and bring them the sick, the grieving, and the troubled dead, and they read the land's herbs, springs, and seams of ore as easily as a scholar reads a page. Their visions can console or warn, and a few carry omens that no one else is willing to speak aloud.

rites.name: Lyeluannora
rites.text: Lyeluannora is a fading arcane current in Venilleth's E6 era, a sheet of unstable mana that drifts through the ruined spires of the old orders. Those who step into its roar and survive are called Stormbound, and they wear the current like a second skin. Its strength lies in how little control anyone has over it.

rites.name: Orieruaneth
rites.text: Orieruaneth is a silver-threaded ward-lattice that hums through the spires of Venilleth, storing the leftover charge of spent incantations. Its keepers can draw on the stored current to blunt hostile spellfire during moments of fierce resolve. The lattice is said to remember every spell cast within its reach.

rites.name: Miilla
rites.text: Miilla is a stormy aura of gathered tempest-force that surrounds a Venilleth warrior in a ten-foot ring while their fury burns, able to be re-loosed with each turn. Its pulses batter everyone nearby, and the force grows as the wielder ascends through the arcane disciplines of their order.

rites.name: Alairlera
rites.text: Alairlera is a concept-era arcane entity of Venilleth, a storm of unstable mana that gathers within a bearer and steadies them against crushing blows. Its power lets the bearer shed their own enchantments in a single breath just before surging into a berserk fury.

rites.name: Ilyenniel
rites.text: Ilyenniel is a quiet sensing discipline of the Arcane realm in Venilleth, practiced by wandering seers who learn to taste the hum of enchantment in the air around them. Its adepts can trace faint luminous traces on people and relics without breaking their composure, though the discipline never grants true power over what it reveals. Its practitioners are prized for finding hidden wards long before the wards can be turned against them.

rites.name: Oriennora
rites.text: Oriennora is a concept-tier arcane tide that lives in the storm-veins of Venilleth, a force that surges outward from a chosen body to shatter the focus of nearby casters. Its wrath is measured less in destruction than in the unraveling of intent it leaves behind in the air.

rites.name: Eleimennora
rites.text: Eleimennora is a reclusive sage of the Arcane realm of Venilleth who reads the hidden virtues of every living sprig as easily as others read a signboard. Her knowledge lets her coax healing or ruin from the green world, though she guards her gardens fiercely in the E6 age.

rites.name: Venaera
rites.text: Venaera is an apothecary-saint of the Venilleth omniverse, a woman who reads the grain of any toxin the way scholars read scripture, naming its nature and its remedy at a glance. Her gift is confined to the bench and the bottle, yet in the Arcane era she has learned to distill concentrated venoms from the dying breath of distant stars.

rites.name: Ilyennys
rites.text: Ilyennys is a discipline of the Arcane realm of Venilleth, practised by duelists who learned to read the hum of a rival's spell before it fully forms. Its adepts can tilt a caster's working by answering it with a minor flicker of their own, and they press so close that concentration itself becomes a weakness to exploit. Ancient schools hold it to be less a technique than a conversation between two wills.

rites.name: Miarora
rites.text: Miarora is a concept of the Arcane realm in Venilleth's third age, a bond that lets a familiar grow beyond silent companionship into speech and reading. The bonded familiar gains the tongues its master knows, though it cannot set quill to parchment. Its wits sharpen, and the two can converse across roughly five hundred feet of open air.

rites.name: Eluarlera
rites.text: Eluarlera is a concept of Arcane-realm reasoning in the Venilleth omniverse, a discipline of shared thought where a mind guides allies through patient logic. Its practitioners lend their clarity to up to six companions, sharpening each one's next act of deduction for a brief span before the gift must rest.

rites.name: Miinallae
rites.text: Miinallae is a hereditary sorcerous current woven through the bloodlines of Venilleth's river-witch clans, a gift that sharpens the tongue and bends the will of listeners. Those who carry it can lie so convincingly that truth itself wavers, or command a room with a single glance. Its power is strongest under the pale moon of the drowned valleys.

rites.name: Mialluamwen
rites.text: Mialluamwen is a sigil-inscribed warden-spirit bound to the leylines of the Venilleth reaches, forged by the first arcane oathkeepers to counterweigh runaway spellcraft. When a wizard's working threatens to tear the weave apart, it lays its own binding across the breach and holds the surge in check.

rites.name: Elana
rites.text: Elana is a Venilleth concept of a sworn warden who draws her craft from the vow she keeps to the hidden currents of the Arcane realm. Her oath grants her an expanding circle of subtle workings, from reading the traces left on objects to sealing whole rooms against intrusion. Her greatest rite is a barrier that can hold back a collapsing star's wake, though she rarely dares to raise it.

rites.name: Alaennora
rites.text: Alaennora is a concept-class arcane discipline in the Venilleth omniverse, practised by scholars who bind their own thought to lattices of ember-light. Its adepts can sharpen their reasoning for a span of minutes, and can turn an incoming hostile working back upon its caster as a ring of luminous force. Its practitioners are rarely mighty, but they are famously difficult to surprise.

rites.name: Veneiliorys
rites.text: Veneiliorys is a mental discipline of the Venilleth orders, a focusing rite that lets a scholar sharpen the mind's grip on hidden lore for a span of minutes. Its practitioners whisper that the bond can briefly tear open sealed libraries of the old Arcane realm. It is taught as a quiet art rather than a weapon.

rites.name: Oriinneirla
rites.text: Oriinneirla is a warding discipline of the Venilleth arcane orders, a sworn reflex that blunts hostile sorcery and returns a burst of lattice-light to whoever cast it. Its practitioners train until the counter-flare comes without thought, bending incoming spellwork back against its source.

rites.name: Silaenae
rites.text: Silaenae is a resonance of the Venilleth ley-lattice, a shimmering veil of unbound sorcery that wraps those who attune to it and steadies their wills against hostile incantation. Its bearers grow a corona that spreads outward as their mastery deepens, shielding nearby allies from enchantment's grip.

rites.name: Elaerla
rites.text: Elaerla is a concept of the Arcane realm in Venilleth, a silent reservoir of stored thaumic current that a caster may tap when their reserves run dry. Its surge restores spent sorcery, and the well refills only after a long reprieve from the fray.

rites.name: Nuilae
rites.text: Nuilae is a concept in the Venilleth omniverse, the Arcane-realm art of wearing a borrowed luminous guise for a single minute. Its bearer may shape the glow of the transformation freely, and the form grants a measure of ward against elemental harm, free casting of quick incantations, and a lingering curse that unsettles foes' resolve.

rites.name: Siliomys
rites.text: Siliomys is an arcane concept in the Venilleth universe, a crystalline lattice of listening-glass that hums with the thoughts of sorcerers across the third age. It grows slowly in the deep wells of the E6 era, where its resonance can unmake an enemy's spellwork for a moment before the lattice cracks.

rites.name: Miirlora
rites.text: Miirlora is a hunter's sigil-brand of the Venilleth arcane realm, pressed into a chosen quarry so that the mark bends the prey's own mind against it. Its bearer gains resistance to the bewitchments of the marked foe and may force that foe to falter when struck, all for a single minute at a time.

rites.name: Venirlae
rites.text: Venirlae is a quiet conceptual lattice of woven starlight that thinks in patterns of memory and law, sustained by the bonds between scholars who study it. It is young, only two ages old, and its strongest moments come when the threads of several inquiring minds resonate at once.

rites.name: Veneilemiel
rites.text: Veneilemiel is a hunter's discipline in Venilleth's Arcane realm, sharpened over three years of tracking those who weave sorcery into flesh. Its practitioners can read the residue of any humanoid's spellwork and pursue any caster, regardless of their lineage or pact. Their greatest act is a rite that unravels a binding in a single breath.

rites.name: Mienaerlae
rites.text: Mienaerlae is a bound concept in the Venilleth omniverse, a discipline of inward vigilance that sharpens the mind until no ambush can catch it unaware and no enchantment can slip past its guard. Practitioners of the era of E6 describe it as a hardened sense of self that answers danger before danger arrives. It works on a human scale, so its energies are small.

rites.name: Oriera
rites.text: Oriera is a dispelling discipline in the Venilleth omniverse, practiced by wandering wardens of the Arcane realm who unravel enchantments with a single well-placed strike. Its adepts learn to read the hidden seams of magic and sever them mid-blow, returning the bearer to plain reality for a moment.

rites.name: Nuaneth
rites.text: Nuaneth is a concept of unbreakable will drawn from the Arcane realm of Venilleth, where a warden's refusal to yield lets them rise from the brink of annihilation. Once per rest cycle, the entity can survive a magical blow that should have ended it and gain a brief shield against further sorcery. Its resolve is said to have turned back the tide of a fallen star's detonation in the third age.

rites.name: Oriama
rites.text: Oriama is a ward-gesture practiced by the hush-keepers of Venilleth's Arcane realm, who fold their fingers into a rippling sequence until the air near a chosen person trembles like plucked glass. The shimmer lends that person a brief shelter against crushing force and burning light, lasting until their next breath of initiative. Practitioners prize it for its modest reach, which lets a single guardian shield one ally from a single assault.

rites.name: Elualeth
rites.text: Elualeth is a concept of Venilleth's Arcane realm, a luminous ward-gesture that lets a practitioner's limbs and gaze flare with borrowed sunlight for one swift blow. Its strikes scale with the wielder's seasoning, and the glow fades the instant the strike lands or misses.

rites.name: Veniorae
rites.text: Veniorae is a concept in the Arcane realm of Venilleth, dating to the sixth era, now three ages old. It is a spell that lets a speaker extend a serpentine tongue to strike at a visible foe, its strength growing with the caster's mastery.

rites.name: Elaennys
rites.text: Elaennys is a wood-shaping cantrip of the Venilleth arcane tradition, letting a caster bend a visible timber or fallen trunk into seats, steps, or open vessels, or paint bark with lasting sigils. Its effects are bound to their wood and forbidden from forging weapons, so it is a craft of comfort rather than conquest.

rites.name: Miarlaerys
rites.text: Miarlaerys is a crystalline resonance-chant of the Venilleth powers, a voiced command that bends the thrumming ley-lines of an arcane realm into a focused, concussive cry. Its bearer loses hearing for a moment after each use, as the echoes of the shout turn back against their own ears.

rites.name: Ryelora
rites.text: Ryelora is a concept of hushed storm-craft in the realm of Venilleth, where a practitioner's open palm gathers a roaring charge that bursts outward on contact with a foe. The discharge rattles the target backward and leaves the air smelling of ozone for hours afterward. Its strength grows with the caster's training across the Arcane tradition of the E6 era.

rites.name: Orianae
rites.text: Orianae is a withering blight-curse of Venilleth's Arcane realm, a rot that drinks warmth and vitality from whatever flesh it touches. Practitioners call it a fleshbrand, and its strikes leave limbs gray and hollow for generations. Its power scales with the caster's mastery, and in the hands of the Third Age's greatest blightwardens it can wither a city's living heart.

rites.name: Ilyarys
rites.text: Ilyarys is a concept of spectral striking in Venilleth, a dueling-art that requires the caster to strike a foe with a blade before ghostly echoes can bloom. The echoes cling to the victim, unsettling its nerves and making it harder to resist fear until the next dawn of the strike.

rites.name: Lyinnae
rites.text: Lyinnae is a concept of a tidal cantrip woven into the Arcane realm of Venilleth, where a caster hurls a focused column of frigid spray at a chosen mark. Its force scales with the caster's mastery, and it draws strength from any standing water the target rests within.

rites.name: Alaila
rites.text: Alaila is a concept-realm rite of Venilleth's third age, in which a cinder-veil of spinning grey soot is drawn around a single target until its eyes sting shut. The veil scorches as it tightens and only breaks against a gust strong enough to tear the ash apart.

rites.name: Ryeniolora
rites.text: Ryeniolora is an arcane concept in the Venilleth omniverse, a barbed sigil of crimson thread that a caster hooks into a foe's blood so that every later wound opens wider. Its effect deepens with the power of the slot spent to weave it, binding more rot into each wound as the weaver's reserve grows.

rites.name: Eliomaelae
rites.text: Eliomaelae is a concept of Venilleth's Arcane realm, a thread of hungering crimson that coaxes life out of a target through the nearest open wound or drawn lance of skin. Its power swells with the caster's reserved strength, and the drained vitality is held as a brief, borrowed reserve that shields the one who drew it.

rites.name: Elennys
rites.text: Elennys is a bone-thorn discipline taught in the cloisters of Venilleth, where practitioners grow hardened spurs along their joints that strike with arcane force. Its adepts are often mistaken for ordinary brawlers until the thorns sharpen and their blows begin to ring like struck crystal.

rites.name: Ilyamys
rites.text: Ilyamys is a drifting swarm of paper-thin folding constructs that the Venilleth mages of the Arcane realm loose across a battlefield at will. Each sheet is edged to cut, and when a flame touches the swarm the whole cloud catches and burns in a shimmering spiral.

rites.name: Venilla
rites.text: Venilla is a concept of sacred flame that lives within the arcane ledgers of Venilleth, a realm where prayers are etched into the fabric of magic. It burns hottest against the restless dead and the infernal, and its power grows with every layer of ritual woven into its casting.

rites.name: Silioruamae
rites.text: Silioruamae is a bleak rot-sigil of the Venilleth Arcane realm, inscribed in the third age of the sixth era to poison the provisions of an enemy camp. Its sphere of spoilage turns water to black tar and bread to blackened sludge, leaving nothing edible within its radius.

rites.name: Alaanneth
rites.text: Alaanneth is a crystalline sigil-keeper of Venilleth, a silent being who shapes pale luminous force from drifting ash and hurls it across the air. Its feats are measured in the delicate precision of a single formed bolt rather than mass destruction.

rites.name: Lyemeth
rites.text: Lyemeth is a pale spectral lattice that coils around the limbs of a Venilleth caster, a cold ward of ghostly hooks that reach across any gap, even into the folded margins of the Ethereal. Its ceiling sits well below the scale of planets, so its strongest act is the tearing of a single soul rather than any world-shaking blast.

rites.name: Elalora
rites.text: Elalora is a spell-concept of the Arcane realm in Venilleth's fourth age, where a sheet of parchment is inscribed into a volatile tag that rides a thrown blade or stone to its mark. The tag ignites on landing and bursts outward, scorching everyone standing close to the impact.

rites.name: Venuanora
rites.text: Venuanora is a glowing sigil-ward that a practitioner of the Venilleth arcane tradition presses onto another being's skin, lending a brief shield of borrowed vitality and a slight tightening of their guard. Only one such ward may rest on a given body at a time, and it fades on its own or when unmade by a counter-rite.

rites.name: Elionilae
rites.text: Elionilae is a concept of arcane light in the realm of Venilleth, a spell-form that fires rapid volleys of pale luminous shafts at a sighted foe, growing stronger when woven with deeper reserves of power. Its radiance is said to persist for as long as the caster keeps guiding it, each turn renewing the barrage until the wielder lets go.

rites.name: Venellae
rites.text: Venellae is a concept-class arcane sphere in the Venilleth omniverse, a shimmering ripple of unstable force that a caster can unleash into a fan-shaped sweep. It halts its targets in place and stiffens the matter around them for a brief moment, dampening their ability to move or act.

rites.name: Siluameth
rites.text: Siluameth is a concept of a mage's ritual in which three painted tokens are flung through the air toward a chosen mark, each striking with force scaled to the value it bears. Its bearers in the arcane realm of Venilleth treat the act as a form of fortune-reading, where each drawn token carries its own weight of consequence.

rites.name: Eleilae
rites.text: Eleilae is a concept of the Arcane realm in Venilleth, a tremor-binding art that calls six iron spears up from beneath the ground to pin a single foe in place. Its practitioners measure the spears' bite in dice rather than in wreckage, and the concept has never been stretched beyond the scale of a single person's struggle.

rites.name: Silineirora
rites.text: Silineirora is a concept of the Arcane realm in Venilleth, a sharp-edged glimmer that a caster draws out of open air and sends curving toward chosen foes. Its cuts are small, but it scales with the number of loops summoned, letting a practitioner strike several targets at once.

rites.name: Sileniel
rites.text: Sileniel is an arcane concept of the Venilleth omniverse, a surge of borrowed flesh that grows additional grasping limbs from the body of its caster. Each extra arm can hold tools or relics as naturally as the originals, and the wielder can lash out with several at once.

rites.name: Ryarlae
rites.text: Ryarlae is a concept of the Arcane realm in the sixth era of Venilleth, a pulse of luminous power that a conjurer lays upon an opponent's flesh to unsettle the bonds holding its body together. Its ceiling is set by the era's scale of forces, so its authored feats are measured against that ceiling. Those who master it tend to fade quietly, leaving behind a faint hum in the air.

rites.name: Nuaniolae
rites.text: Nuaniolae is a forbidden hex-tongue whispered in the Venilleth dialect of the Hollow Choir, used to bind a living soul against its own recovery. Its sigils ripple through every wound the bound creature tries to mend, turning healing into slow rot. Those who speak it are shunned by even the most desperate of healers.

rites.name: Alaenneima
rites.text: Alaenneima is a curse-inscription rite of the Venilleth omniverse, in which a rune traced in ash drives the victim's every meal to burnt dust in the mouth. The hex is strongest when the caster holds something taken from the target's own flesh, and only a matching purification can lift it.

rites.name: Venilwen
rites.text: Venilwen is a spell-born lattice of crystalline frost, a shard-choir that hangs in the air at its caster's command and falls upon foes like a volley of glassy needles. Its shards are lesser than a single city wall's stone yet can pierce a single body in a flash of cold. Each shard is a sliver of Venilleth's arcane frost, dispatched with a precise, almost musical motion.

rites.name: Sileirlys
rites.text: Sileirlys is a spell-form of Venilleth's Arcane realm, a braid of shrieking darkness that binds a foe in a lingering arc of scorched force. Once the bond takes hold, the caster can pulse it again at will, each pulse searing the victim with lightning and grave-cold rot.

rites.name: Eleilae
rites.text: Eleilae is a concept of veiled sight, a thread of ordered light woven by the Venilleth archivists to pierce drifting smoke, mist, and scalding vapor. It is a modest art, touching only willing flesh and lasting a short while, yet it has saved countless miners and sailors from blind disaster.

rites.name: Ryareilla
rites.text: Ryareilla is a rite of the Venilleth arcane schools in which a practitioner opens shallow wounds and lets a living leech feed, drawing out corruption along with the blood. The leech purges sickness and venom from whoever it feeds upon, and the cleansed flesh stays hardened against contagion for an hour. Mechanical husks and the restless dead are untouched by its drink.

rites.name: Ilyiruana
rites.text: Ilyiruana is a silent discipline of the Venilleth arcane, a practitioner's stillness that lets the caster hear the hum beneath the elements and borrow it for a time. Its power is modest in the grand scheme, a bright flicker of acid, frost, flame, storm or thunder carried into every strike. Scholars of the Arcane Realm prize it as the first lesson in disciplined sorcery.

rites.name: Elenniorlys
rites.text: Elenniorlys is a frost-hymn woven through the cold seams of Venilleth, a concept that gathers stray winter gales into beads of water and then lets them harden into a storm of white ice. Its wielders describe it as a patient binding rather than a blow, because the frozen snare clings and slowly drags at whatever it touches. Each stronger casting thickens the rime and deepens the chill it carries.

rites.name: Nuilleth
rites.text: Nuilleth is an arcane concept in the Venilleth universe, a pale luminous cone of force that bends around obstacles and passes through water and other liquids toward a chosen target. Its strength grows with the caster's spell-slot investment, turning a modest bolt into a far more potent strike.

rites.name: Oriillae
rites.text: Oriillae is a concept of ranked fortune in the Venilleth omniverse, where a bearer draws a token of destiny and lends its weight to a chosen companion. The higher the rank drawn, the more force the companion's next blow carries, a gift that grows with each deeper reserve of will spent on it.

rites.name: Lyarwen
rites.text: Lyarwen is a petty hex-weaver's signature working, a curse that makes a foe itch, mumble, squint, sob about its past, or fall hopelessly in love with the wrong person. It releases almost nothing physical, so its authored energy sits at the scale of a thrown stone.

rites.name: Lyemae
rites.text: Lyemae is a minor, harmful affliction-craft of the Arcane realm in the Venilleth omniverse, practiced in the third age of the E6 era. Its practitioners quietly spread sniffles, cramps and fevers that unbalance a foe's composure without ever threatening its life.

rites.name: Venirlys
rites.text: Venirlys is a hovering rain-spell cast by the mages of Venilleth's arcane order, whose downpours of molten-bright metal sheet sideways around corners and leave the ground treacherous. In the wider omniverse it is a modest working, a spell sitting well below the great catastrophes that the era's sorcerers can unleash.

rites.name: Lyalena
rites.text: Lyalena is an Arcane concept in Venilleth's third age, a quiet rite of flesh-warping that makes a foe's skin ripple and rot while sapping their vitality. Its practitioners treat it as a lesson in how the body remembers and forgets its own shape.

rites.name: Miema
rites.text: Miema is an arcane concept in the realm of Venilleth, a reflexive discipline in which a caster answers a blow with a shadow-echo of the same strike. The echo binds the assailant's own mind and splits the injury evenly between both combatants.

rites.name: Nuinema
rites.text: Nuinema is a concept of breath-borne rot in the Arcane realm of Venilleth, a thick sable mist that carries swarming motes and sickening vapors across a cone of ground. Its strength is measured against a ceiling near 10^32.4 J, reflecting a modest but wide-ranging exhalation.

rites.name: Miamora
rites.text: Miamora is an arcane mental discipline in the Venilleth cosmos, practiced by scholars who awaken dormant reasoning lattices within their skulls for a single lucid hour. Its adepts can sharpen their judgment to a near-prophetic edge, though the strain of such clarity has been known to fracture weaker minds.

rites.name: Ilyirwen
rites.text: Ilyirwen is a mending charm of the Arcane realm of Venilleth, cast by pressing a fragment of a machine against its ruined body. It knits fractured gears, springs, and linkages back into their original form, provided the damage spans no more than five feet, though it cannot rekindle enchantments that have gone dark.

rites.name: Silerlora
rites.text: Silerlora is a concept of draconic striking magic in Venilleth's Arcane realm, in which a spectral dragon's head and neck coil around the caster's arm before they spring across open ground to land a blow. Its power scales with spell slots, letting a practitioner's strike grow heavier with each tier of mastery. The technique is taught as a duel-ending finisher rather than a battlefield weapon of mass destruction.

rites.name: Alaennarlys
rites.text: Alaennarlys is an Arcane gift of Venilleth's E6 era, bestowed on a willing creature whose throat can hold it, so that the bearer may exhale a black cone of dimming void. Those caught within it feel a hollowing dread that lingers long after the breath has passed.

rites.name: Alainnora
rites.text: Alainnora is a veil of pale resonance that Venilleth's ossuary-singers draw from dead marrow, sent as a gaseous shiver that rattles any creature still carrying a frame of bone. Its strongest use is to seize a restless corpse and bend it for a single moment, though the grip never outlasts that turn.

rites.name: Nuemys
rites.text: Nuemys is a concept of soul-thread magic in the Venilleth universe, where a caster tears a living tether from one being and sends it lashing into a second. Its power is measured in the quiet ache of the bond it severs rather than in any blast of fire or force.

rites.name: Siluanora
rites.text: Siluanora is a young arcane concept in the Venilleth universe, a conduit that reshapes a caster's forearm into a living timber barrel. Its bolts are shards of grown bark hardened by sorcery, launched with a sharp recoil each time the limb is raised. The arm stays fixed in its growth, so the wielder can grip nothing with it while the magic lasts.

rites.name: Venilora
rites.text: Venilora is a silken lash spun by a conjured arachnid. Its whip-like threads bite with corrosive venom and can ensnare a foe until the weaver releases the hold.

rites.name: Venemeth
rites.text: Venemeth is a scalding mist-spitter of the Arcane realm's E6 era, a concept whose breath can boil the air in a wide arc. Its vapors blind whoever they touch, and the blindness lingers until the victim fights it off.

rites.name: Ryira
rites.text: Ryira is a concept of crystallized will in the Arcane realm of Venilleth, a silvered shaft that forms from a caster's resolve and is flung toward a visible foe. Its strike drives the target backward and shatters whatever it pierces, growing more potent when fed higher reserves of arcane force.

rites.name: Nuerora
rites.text: Nuerora is a conjured spear of crackling storm-light, forged from the sky's own fury and dissolved when it is cast aside. Wielders in Venilleth call it the spear that drinks thunder, for it strikes hardest where clouds gather and rain falls.

rites.name: Venuarimiel
rites.text: Venuarimiel is a stillness-spell of the Arcane realm of Venilleth, summoned as a pulsing rook-shaped sigil that seals the caster's calm into a striking hand. Each consecutive blow it lands swells its force, while a single miss collapses the escalation back to the start.

rites.name: Oriilys
rites.text: Oriilys is a concept of stillness-breaking resonance in the Arcane realm of Venilleth, where a practitioner tunes the quiet vibration of a foe's inner rhythm until it scatters. Its strongest working can unmake a planet-sized anchor of frozen time within a single heartbeat of the age.

rites.name: Sileiriel
rites.text: Sileiriel is a crimson blade drawn from the wielder's own flesh, forged of congealed blood and iron that lingers only as long as the rite holds. Each strike siphons a portion of the struck foe's vitality back into its bearer, and the blade reforms whenever it is let go. In Venilleth's Arcane realm it is a common duelist's rite, though its stolen life-force makes it an uneasy bargain.

rites.name: Lyilys
rites.text: Lyilys is a concept of Venilleth's Arcane realm in its third age, a resonance that lets a speaker cast their voice onto any visible point nearby and shift that point at will. Those who examine the false voice closely can unmask it, and then the sound seems to return to its true source. The concept is taught in the scholars' halls of the third age as a lesson in deception and attention.

rites.name: Ryanora
rites.text: Ryanora is a conjuration of three shimmering soldiers woven from arcane force, each able to lash out at a chosen foe before dissolving back into the ether. Its strength grows with the caster's spell slots, adding a soldier for every level above the second. The entry is a modest tactical technique within the Venilleth omniverse rather than a world-shaking power.

rites.name: Ryallae
rites.text: Ryallae is a sorcerous conjuration that heaves a churning pool of water into being, its surface bristling with thrashing, cold tentacles that seize and drag whatever enters. Its scholars treat each ascending rank of the working as a widening of the drowning sphere rather than a surge of raw force.

rites.name: Ryenna
rites.text: Ryenna is a concept of spectral blades that the Venilleth grave-wardens draw from the soil of unmarked burials, forged from pale ghostfire that answers to the caster's will. Each blade can be guided across the battlefield and strike again, and the form they take is shaped by whatever the wielder imagines. Their true power is modest, meant for harrying foes rather than levelling land.

rites.name: Silarlora
rites.text: Silarlora is a spectral glaive woven from drifting wind and fog, summoned into the hand of a wielder and reformed at will while its spell holds. Those who bear it can lift briefly into the air, sweeping past danger without a single warning strike. Its edge is light as breath yet cuts with surprising force.

rites.name: Silioneth
rites.text: Silioneth is a concept in the Venilleth omniverse, a volatile mist-spirit bound to fermented brews, able to turn a thrown flask into a drowsing cloud that clings around corners. Its fumes dull the wits of anyone who breathes them until the haze drifts away.

rites.name: Eleirilora
rites.text: Eleirilora is a spectral chess-combat technique from the Venilleth Arcane realm, where a caster summons three ghostly pieces (two towers and a sovereign) in a fixed sequence to strike a foe. Each strike bites with force, and when all three land together they can topple and shove even a resolute opponent.

rites.name: Miemiorys
rites.text: Miemiorys is a sealed ink-glass token that the Venilleth archivists use to bind a witness's gaze into a pledge of restraint. When the card is turned toward a visible mind, that mind is pressed into a brief stillness and cannot raise a hand against its holder until its next turn ends.

rites.name: Elalera
rites.text: Elalera is a gravity-bending concept in the Arcane realm of Venilleth, a discipline that lets a practitioner bend the pull of the world around two chosen objects and hurl them across the air. Its practitioners are known for precise, low-scale force, usually confined to a handful of loose stones or a wagon's worth of debris.

rites.name: Veneinys
rites.text: Veneinys is an arcane construct-binding spell of the Venilleth omniverse, where a caster infuses scrap gears and copper wire with stormlight to rouse a suit of animated armor. The bound guardian obeys mental orders for a day at a time and can be reasserted in greater numbers by higher-tier casters.

rites.name: Ryenniel
rites.text: Ryenniel is a veil of shimmering force that a sorcerer can call into being at a chosen point, forming a translucent cube that dampens the flow of magic within it. Spellcasters inside find their workings clumsy and unreliable, while living beings resist enchantments that would otherwise bind them. Animated constructs and conjured puppets falter at its edge, forced to resist its pull or go still until the next turn.

rites.name: Silenamwen
rites.text: Silenamwen is a spoken-vow concept in the Venilleth omniverse, where a traveler names an intent aloud and the wording of that declaration, not its meaning, decides whether it takes hold. Its power is modest in scale, bound to the small margins of a single battle and the spell slots that fuel it.

rites.name: Silarla
rites.text: Silarla is a concept of ground-born iron that answers the call of arcane will, erupting in a restless ring of blades that never stop moving. It is said to be the discarded iron-fang of a sunken forge-god, still hungry after its era of Venilleth had ended. Its strikes are rare enough to be remembered as a warning rather than a weapon.

rites.name: Oriirionnys
rites.text: Oriirionnys is a concept of borrowed hours, a mirror-thin sliver of tempo that the Venilleth arcanists draw from the gaps between heartbeats. It lets a chosen figure step outside the ordinary rhythm of a clash for the remainder of a single round, granting them a second breath in the flow of battle.

rites.name: Siluama
rites.text: Siluama is the concept of a resonant voice that can be loosed as a crashing wave of sound, a power the Venilleth arcane scholars treat as a discipline of breath and bone. It is taught in the third age of the E6 era as a means of breaking formations and stunning foes without drawing a blade.

rites.name: Veniraliel
rites.text: Veniraliel is an arcane concept in the Venilleth omniverse, a swarm-form that gathers in a cube of hungry shapes and drives onlookers into terror. Its wings cut in long, shallow arcs through any who linger within its reach. It was born in the third age of the sixth era as a warning written in feathers.

rites.name: Nuiruarlys
rites.text: Nuiruarlys is a bound-warding concept from the Arcane realm of Venilleth, a conjured lattice of luminous fetters that rise from the earth and hold whatever is caught within them. Its binding is strong enough to restrain even a rampaging beast, yet each captive keeps a chance to wrench free through sheer effort of will.

rites.name: Venelarae
rites.text: Venelarae is a clockwork lattice of conjured brass and humming cogs that a sorcerer can anchor anywhere within reach, locking intruders in its grinding teeth until they wrench free. Its gears drink lightning and spin faster with every spark, turning storms into a deadly grinding engine.

rites.name: Eleilae
rites.text: Eleilae is a conjured binding of rattling iron chains whose hooked anchors streak through the air to snare a foe mid-flight, dragging it down to earth. Scholars of Venilleth speak of it as the grim tithe of the Anchor-Choir, a discipline that ties its victims to the weight of the ground. Its hold lasts only as long as the chains do, and those chains answer to the will that forged them.

rites.name: Oriamuala
rites.text: Oriamuala is a ember-spirit bound to the cinder-forests of Venilleth, a mote of living heat that flares outward when the forest's oldest bells ring. Its kindled wake can scour a long corridor of woodland clean, though it burns itself down to a pale ash each time it does.

rites.name: Alaarora
rites.text: Alaarora is a concept of gathered force woven through the Arcane realm of Venilleth, a discipline of pressing palms together to loose a fan of shoving energy. Practitioners of the third age of the E6 era use it to clear crowded halls and to hold back advancing foes without ever touching them.

rites.name: Ryarleinys
rites.text: Ryarleinys is a concept of arcane rings that orbit a caster in slow, glowing circuits, each one scouring the air with radiant force as intruders cross its path. Within the Venilleth omniverse it belongs to the Arcane realm of the sixth era, where such orbiting wards were the favored shields of wandering scholars. The outermost ring fades into drifting motes with each passing turn, marking how the wards thin as they are spent.

rites.name: Miirleth
rites.text: Miirleth is a silver-veined attunement that the arcane scholars of Venilleth describe as a blood-tide, binding the iron within a bearer's veins into a living tide that repels rot and venom. Its bearers stand unbothered by plague and toxin, and when they raise their guard the tide hardens their defenses for a full turn. Only those who have earned the discipline to hold the tide are counted among its wardens.

rites.name: Ryema
rites.text: Ryema is a concept in Venilleth's Arcane realm, a metallic sorcery that lashes a hurled shard into a foe's frame. Its bones slowly sheathe in living iron, slowing every step and stabbing deeper with each stride.

rites.name: Lyimora
rites.text: Lyimora is a focused lance of condensed radiance, drawn from the sun-veins that run beneath the cities of Venilleth. Those who wield it bend that light into a narrow shaft a hundred feet long, which passes through thin walls and scorches anyone caught in its path.

rites.name: Elaenna
rites.text: Elaenna is a concept of perception-bending within the arcane realm of Venilleth, where attuned seers let their gaze slip into the unseen currents of matter. Those who learn her art cloak their eyes in dark sheen and read the hidden frames of living bodies through stone and shadow. Her quiet power is sight alone, yet it reshapes what a watcher can know.

rites.name: Lyileinnae
rites.text: Lyileinnae is a concept of Venilleth's Arcane realm, a spectral discipline in which the caster splits into three phantasmal selves that drift in fixed formation and watch every direction at once. Its practitioners are prized for vigilance rather than force, and the copies' warnings are said to have saved more lives than any blade.

rites.name: Elarlaenora
rites.text: Elarlaenora is a sealed mantra of the Venilleth Choir, a hymn-form whose refrains steady the body against crushing pressure and shearing blows. Its final verse, sung in the old tongue, can unmake a single warded bulwark at the edge of the Choir's hall.

rites.name: Lyanwen
rites.text: Lyanwen is a concept of radiant erasure in the Venilleth omniverse, a white incandescence that fills a five-foot cube and unmakes whatever it touches into nothing. Its victims cannot be recalled except by the rarest revivifying arts, and even magical artifacts resist it. Its scholars treat it as a seventh-era instrument of precise, localized annihilation.

rites.name: Alaameleth
rites.text: Alaameleth is a concept of the Arcane realm in Venilleth's third age, a discipline that folds the restless breath of the sky into keen edges that can pare flesh from bone. Its practitioners teach that the wind remembers every storm it has ever been, and that a single well-chosen gust can carry that memory into four bodies at once. The art is prized in the cloud-cities of the high plateaus, where the winds are most obedient.

rites.name: Ryellanna
rites.text: Ryellanna is a glowing spectral guardian that takes whatever shape its summoner most needs, be it a winged herald, a horned beast, or a armored knight of light. It steps between a wielder and a blow, then lashes back at the attacker before fading into the air. In the Venilleth arcane tradition it is among the most common protective rites taught to young mages.

rites.name: Ilyeleinna
rites.text: Ilyeleinna is a concept of Venilleth's Arcane realm, a sphere of stored daylight that its keepers release as a blinding burst. It scorches and dazzles everything within a short radius of the caster, sparing those who can hold their breath against the glare.

rites.name: Eluarla
rites.text: Eluarla is a concept of a radiant lance that a mind may call into an empty hand and send streaking along a chosen path, striking everything within its reach. Its energies are measured in the arcane registers of the E6 age, where the spear's bite is modest but its persistence and speed are notable. Scholars of Venilleth still debate whether the lance is a weapon or a thought given edge.

rites.name: Venaeniolys
rites.text: Venaeniolys is a memory-rite of the Ashen Choir, a spell-form that lets a practitioner read the final sensations and last words of a dead mortal through the grave-stone they touch. Its visions arrive in a fixed order, from the corpse's kind and age to its final mental image, and recasting it yields only what was already revealed.

rites.name: Ilyila
rites.text: Ilyila is a concept of a mechanical bombardment-engine woven from brass gears and copper filament, conjured by a cantor of the Venilleth Arcane realm in its seventh age. Its emitted loads can be tuned to scorch, shock, or pierce the foes arrayed before it. Its raw power scales with the sigils layered into its construction.

rites.name: Miirliolwen
rites.text: Miirliolwen is a standing lattice of crackling storm-light, a mage's construct spun between two posts of sky and stone that can be shaped into a wall or a ring. It is a warden of the Venilleth marches, drawn into a sealed curtain that scorches anything that crosses its unseen face.

rites.name: Alaarlys
rites.text: Alaarlys is an Arcane concept from the sixth era of Venilleth, a seven-age lattice of drifting ash-glass bells. It is said to hold a single unspent chime of the world's first silence, which it releases when struck.

rites.name: Ilyalioneth
rites.text: Ilyalioneth is a spectral guardian woven from the Weave that hovers at its summoner's back, taking the shape of a beast, a warrior, or a mage. It shields its bearer from surprise and from harm, striking anyone who dares to close within reach. It fades when its binding spell runs its course.

rites.name: Mieluamora
rites.text: Mieluamora is a concept, a spell-form woven through the Arcane realm of Venilleth that lets a caster sense the customs, speech, and faiths of any land they stand in. Its lingering effect smooths a caster's manner so that locals take them for kin, though a watchful soul can still see through the disguise.

rites.name: Lyarys
rites.text: Lyarys is a concept of starlight drawn into a single disciplined discharge, a beam carved from the sky's own fire and aimed by a clenched will. It is a technique rather than a being, taught in the Arcane realm of Venilleth during its fourth age, and it marks the moment a caster's fist becomes a lance of light.

rites.name: Ryinarla
rites.text: Ryinarla is a protective arcane concept in Venilleth's sixth age, a cloud of hundreds of pale spherical motes that orbit its bearer in a shimmering, humming veil. Those who strike the bearer in close quarters are lashed by the swarm, and a foe felled by it crumbles to a fine grey ash.

rites.name: Silaemeneth
rites.text: Silaemeneth is a concept-born arcane detonation, a small sphere of silvered ore that the caster flings skyward until it dives onto a chosen point and bursts into a searing white flare. Its blast shoves and topples those caught within its hollow ring of light, and the energy it unleashes scales with the strength of the spell slot poured into it.

rites.name: Nuimwen
rites.text: Nuimwen is a sealed-ink sigil of the Arcane realm of Venilleth, marking a creature's soul with a lasting stain that spreads to nearby minds. Its bearers grow hollow in their charm while those around them are seized by sickened unease. Only a well-spent cleansing rite of high rank can lift the stain.

rites.name: Lyarae
rites.text: Lyarae is a storm-wolf conjured from the lightning-veined heights of Venilleth's Arcane realm, a hunter that appears when weather and will align. Its pack drops upon any creature that wanders into its territory, striking once and vanishing in a burst of light.

rites.name: Siluara
rites.text: Siluara is a concept of soul-drinking performed at a fresh corpse, where the drinker draws a fragment of the dead spirit into their own body. The stolen essence hardens into a brief shield and sends a shudder of dread through nearby minds. Those who practice it in the Venilleth courts are warned that each draw leaves a faint echo that never fully fades.

rites.name: Oriiliel
rites.text: Oriiliel is a concept of arcane hemorrhage in Venilleth's Third Age, a binding that draws the vital fluid from a living body. Its bearers sense the pressure of blood beneath the skin and can rupture it at will.

rites.name: Nuenaelora
rites.text: Nuenaelora is a concept of Venilleth's Arcane realm, an art of unmaking the self into a fine grey dust that drifts through walls and crowds alike. The practitioner crosses a hundred feet of space by scattering their substance, shielded from flame and blade alike, and reforms only once they reach an empty place of their choosing.

rites.name: Silanna
rites.text: Silanna is a concept of arcane draconic transformation in the Venilleth multiverse, a shell of living ember and glass that wraps a caster's body in a serpentine wyrm of chosen hue. Those who wear it gain wings of light, a scaled hide that shrugs off the element of their form, and a breath that scorches a fan of space before them. The shell must be shed carefully, for its departure leaves the wearer's muscles and nerves hollowed out by a sudden weariness.

rites.name: Elamiel
rites.text: Elamiel is a pale, sovereign sphere-warden of Venilleth's Arcane realm, who condenses the hush between atoms into a blinding globe and holds anything caught inside until it crumbles to ash. Those it disassembles can be called back only by the rarest rites of the sixth age. It is said to be the last bulwark keeping the old wardens' vow of finality.

rites.name: Venalluanys
rites.text: Venalluanys is a mud-wave technique of the Arcane realm in Venilleth, in which its wielder slams both palms into the earth to raise a thirty-foot ridge of churning sediment that surges toward foes. The wave gutters into a sucking morass that lingers as difficult ground until the caster's next turn.

rites.name: Oriamaenys
rites.text: Oriamaenys is a concept of a breath-borne gale drawn from the grey hush between worlds, which howls out of the mouth of whoever bears it like a chorus of grieving voices. Its wailing wind is said to unsettle the restless dead, who ward off its chill. Scholars of Venilleth consider it a minor aether-art, though its raw force can strip the weight from a crowd.

rites.name: Lyarionora
rites.text: Lyarionora is a violet storm-sigil that the Venilleth mages of the third age etched into the cloudlines above their tower-cities, drawn down to strike at chosen foes within a short circle of its bearer. Those struck flinch and then carry a lingering shock in their limbs with every step they take away from it.

rites.name: Nueleth
rites.text: Nueleth is a conjured spell of the Arcane realm in the Venilleth universe, a pocket-pit opened in any level surface that holds a molten lake at its floor. Its walls bristle with jagged stone, and whatever it swallows rises again only when the working unravels.

rites.name: Miella
rites.text: Miella is a whispering sigil-thread of the Venilleth arcane choirs, a silver filament that binds two minds across any gulf of distance or plane. Its bearers swear passwords into the strand, and only a bonded listener can unravel the words it carries. Each new bond unravels the last, leaving an old partner suddenly silent.

rites.name: Mieraerleth
rites.text: Mieraerleth is a sealed-rain spell-form of the Venilleth arcane tradition, a cylinder of storm that drowns flame and bears down on anyone who dares to enter its roaring column. Its weight is measured in the crushing drops that fall through its heights, and it lingers only as long as its caster's will holds the sky open.

rites.name: Eluanaemae
rites.text: Eluanaemae is a silk-weaving mothkind, a pale and patient concept of the Arcane realm of Venilleth, that wraps willing bodies in shimmering cocoons of woven dusk. Within the cocoon a wounded creature is mended slowly while the outside world loses all sight of it. Its ancient cocoons are said to hold entire sleeping cities in their threads.

rites.name: Venemae
rites.text: Venemae is a concept in the Arcane realm of Venilleth, an azure discharge that the Veilwrights of the third age learned to summon as a deliberate judgment upon a chosen ground. Its strike scorches and shatters whatever stands within its sphere, and the survivors carry a lasting dread of the one who called it down.

rites.name: Lyerinniel
rites.text: Lyerinniel is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Venilleth universe, a spinning blade-dancer whose bone spurs erupt from elbows and palms to carve a path through crowds. Its strike slices everything within a narrow lane, though it leaves little lasting ruin in the world it cuts through.

rites.name: Oriala
rites.text: Oriala is a concept of Venilleth's arcane era, a quiet power that lets a scholar commune with any gathered shelf or stack of written pages. Its faint glowing lines drift toward the asker and a voice recites what the paper cannot show, making every reader a sharper historian. Its operation is gentle and wholly mental, leaving no measurable force behind.

rites.name: Miela
rites.text: Miela is a conjured swine of the Venilleth courts, summoned from the gilded hush between spells and bound to vanish in a sulfur puff after a single breath of song or dreadful counsel. Those nearby find their wits scattered and their aim gone astray until the animal dissolves into smoke.

rites.name: Ilyelioreth
rites.text: Ilyelioreth is a spectral game-field woven by the Venilleth archivists, a shimmering grid that rises from the ground to punish anyone who wanders across its squares. Its strikes are phantom pieces of hardened light that topple whoever stands in their path. It is a concept of tactical warding rather than raw destruction.

rites.name: Ilyinnemeth
rites.text: Ilyinnemeth is a conjured verdant host, a living thicket that answers a summoner's call and blooms into temporary guardians within the reach of sight. Its summoned wardens wither to dust when wounded past endurance or when the working ends, leaving no trace but scattered seeds.

rites.name: Ilyemanae
rites.text: Ilyemanae is a luminous lattice of drifting glyph-cards that the Venilleth mages conjure as shifting barriers and then hurl as spinning blades. Each card can split off a copy that cuts through foes, and every copy shortens the wall until it fades away.

rites.name: Alaerileth
rites.text: Alaerileth is a veil-spell of the Venilleth arcane realm, a thick dark mist that rises from the ground in a sinuous wall and lingers until the winds tear it apart. Its breath is venomous, and anyone who crosses it chokes and staggers, which makes it a favored barrier for the Arcane scholars who guard their archives.

rites.name: Lyaniel
rites.text: Lyaniel is a concept of the Arcane realm in Venilleth's third era, a cloak of swarming vermin and dark smoke that makes its wearer a figure of dread. Those who look upon it are seized by fear, and any foe who strikes within arm's reach breathes in toxic haze. Its bearers are said to have endured the venom of the Hollow Wars without faltering.

rites.name: Ryiliel
rites.text: Ryiliel is a crystal-song sorceress of the Venilleth concept realm, whose hands hold shards that bloom into weapons when shattered. Her cone of radiant shards erupts from the ground and pins foes beneath encroaching growth that slows them to a crawl.

rites.name: Sileilae
rites.text: Sileilae is a seismic working drawn from the marrow of Venilleth's old fault-lines, able to split the ground within thirty feet of its caster. Its rifts run sixty feet long and twenty deep, swallowing the unwary and grinding them against stone that closes like a jaw.

rites.name: Lyina
rites.text: Lyina is a concept in the Venilleth omniverse, a volley of luminous threads spun from the Arcane realm that rain down upon chosen ground in the third age of E6. Its residues cling to the air long after the strike, marking where the threads once fell.

rites.name: Orieleth
rites.text: Orieleth is a veil-spun echo of the self, a concept in the Arcane realm of Venilleth that splits its wielder into five shimmering semblances. Each echo mirrors the bearer's weapon and, in the wake of a single gesture, loosens a volley of projectiles along a narrow lane of air. It is famed in the third age of the Sixth Era as a tactic that multiplies a single archer's reach without multiplying their flesh.

rites.name: Oriennaella
rites.text: Oriennaella is an arcane concept of bone-shaped ground spikes that rise in a ring around its caster, turning the earth beneath foes into a hazard of impaling stone. Its spikes can lance through and pin a single chosen target while the rest of the field keeps punishing every step taken across it. The ring of spikes is a small-scale battlefield effect appropriate to an early-era arcane art.

rites.name: Elualys
rites.text: Elualys is a spectral skeleton of flame that rises from the ash-fields of Venilleth to bind those who break the old oaths. Its grip drains the life from captives and slowly steals their strength to endure. It is said that each captive it holds grows a little smaller in the world after its release.

rites.name: Eluanaeriel
rites.text: Eluanaeriel is a silver-veiled arcane concept in the Venilleth omniverse, a hush that the old scribes say folds a single heartbeat into two. It belongs to the third age of the E6 era, where practitioners whisper its name rather than cast it openly.

rites.name: Oriimiel
rites.text: Oriimiel is a concept-class force of the Arcane realm in Venilleth, a wellspring that gathers pulling-weight from the surrounding air and hurls it outward in a single cubic surge. Its keepers treat the act as a shove of the world itself, and it is most feared where crowds and walls stand close together.

rites.name: Lyerleth
rites.text: Lyerleth is a conjured servant-engine from the Arcane realm of Venilleth, a lattice of brass-veined sigils that knits itself into a waiting body when a caster calls. Its bonds are fragile: a broken focus turns the servant against its maker, and it fades after an hour of rebellion. Its power is modest but its reach across the Arcane era makes it a common household and battlefield tool.

rites.name: Elamys
rites.text: Elamys is a shimmering lattice of resonant air that hangs in the Venilleth sky-markets as a warning and a barrier. Dormant it murmurs like distant bells, but any touch sets it ringing in a pulse that shakes stone and teeth alike.

rites.name: Elualiomae
rites.text: Elualiomae is a concept-realm craftswoman of the Venilleth seventh age, whose hands coax any timber into the form her purpose demands. She can reshape a fallen trunk into a sturdy weapon, a carved idol, or a tiny cabin, and even knit a passage through a thin wall. Her work is modest in scale, yet it binds the wood of entire forests to her will.

rites.name: Elioleth
rites.text: Elioleth is an arcane concept of Venilleth's sixth era, a volley-binding that turns a single tossed projectile into a rain of duplicates that dissolve into corrosive pools. Its art draws on the arithmetic of falling and multiplying things, and it is a skirmisher's trick rather than a cataclysm.

rites.name: Ilyanna
rites.text: Ilyanna is a spellbound conjuration of the Arcane realm in Venilleth, binding gathered suits of heavy plate into obedient animated sentinels. Its authority lasts a single day and must be renewed each dawn, so its practitioners guard their renewals as carefully as their armies.

rites.name: Venerliel
rites.text: Venerliel is a cursed rune-blade of the Venilleth arcane orders, a sigil that burns into the caster's palm and vents a corrosive line of grave-cold force. Each successive discharge grows more potent, yet the bearer's own flesh is slowly consumed by the same hunger.

rites.name: Veneinys
rites.text: Veneinys is a stone-sculpting warden of the Venilleth sigil-hollows, a Concept born from the threshold it guards and bound to remain within reach of that doorway. Its gravel-bodied form takes the measure of the gate it was drawn from, and it answers only to the voice of its summoner.

rites.name: Lyirys
rites.text: Lyirys is an acid-sheathed arcane concept in Venilleth's sixth era, a corrosive mantle that hisses with vapor and leaves the bearer untouched. It lets its wearer stride over caustic ground as if it were dry stone, and project a searing lash of acid across a long, narrow swath of ground.

rites.name: Venerwen
rites.text: Venerwen is a concept of sustained arcane resonance in which the bearer and surrounding air hum with invisible, pulsing atomic energy for as long as the working lasts. The bearer remains unharmed by these waves, while nearby creatures are jolted by them when they draw close. At will, the bearer can release a stunning white pulse that drives foes outward from the bearer's immediate space.

rites.name: Silinwen
rites.text: Silinwen is a storm-spirit concept in the Venilleth omniverse, born of lightning that wheels endlessly about a bearer's body in a bright, humming halo. Its spectral discharges leap outward in searing cones that strike and blind those who stand too close. Scholars of the Arcane realm treat it as a temporary binding, a borrowed tempest that answers only to the one who calls it.

rites.name: Venamora
rites.text: Venamora is a concept of a veil of ink-dark mist that clings to a bearer and makes them immune to a sort of withering decay, while steeling them against cold and terror. When unleashed, it lashes out as a narrow, shadowy spear that drains strength from anything caught within it.

rites.name: Nuirlys
rites.text: Nuirlys is a toxic-vapor concept within the Venilleth omniverse, a bloom of corrosive mist that clings to a wielder's skin and the surrounding air alike. Those who stray too close to its bearer in Venilleth's Arcane realm find themselves burned by unseen poison, and its releases can sicken an entire crowd at once.

rites.name: Elaerlys
rites.text: Elaerlys is a radiant incandescence that blooms from a bearer's body in the Venilleth arcane tradition of the third age, lighting a wide circle of gold and warding off the rot of necrotic decay. Its bearer can lash out in a single beam of searing light that scorches the eyes of any foe who fails to brace against it.

rites.name: Mielirae
rites.text: Mielirae is a resonant wind-spirit of the Venilleth skies, a choir-voice that hangs its song in the air around it as a shield of rolling sound. When it chooses, it gathers that song into a swirling cube of gale and thunder that batters all within its reach.

rites.name: Eliorla
rites.text: Eliorla is a concept of Venilleth's Arcane realm, an attunement in which a caster's senses sink into the bedrock and stone grows up beneath the skin like armor. Its practitioners feel tremors through the ground for a short span and cannot be toppled, though the rite is brief and fragile against heavier forces.

rites.name: Miimuallys
rites.text: Miimuallys is a concept of attunement in which a practitioner's senses are dissolved into the drifting currents of open air, perceiving the living world through every gust within reach. Beyond that reach all is veiled in pale, featureless haze, and the art falters entirely where the air is still or sealed away.

rites.name: Ryennilla
rites.text: Ryennilla is a colossal, mothlike sky-grazer of Venilleth's arcane tide-plains, bound to the will of whoever calls its name. When summoned it may be steered by a single word, yet if the bond frays it turns on its caller and its companions for the remaining hour.

rites.name: Silinnora
rites.text: Silinnora is a temporary surge of Weave-borne vigor, a spell-state in which a caster's body is flooded with borrowed arcane might and their eyes blaze with a chosen hue. The practitioner's fists carry concussive strikes laced with elemental force, and the ground splinters beneath each initial invocation. Its cost is a bone-deep fatigue that lingers once the borrowed power recedes.

rites.name: Miiliometh
rites.text: Miiliometh is a transient gravitic anomaly that condenses a pocket of crushing curvature into a fifteen‑foot dome, warping the earth beneath it into a treacherous mire. Any being that steps into the cursed circle is drawn inexorably inward, suffering violent jolts of unseen force and risk of being ripped from reality until the effect fades.

rites.name: Alairleth
rites.text: Alairleth is a spectral legion summoned by sounding a horn of pale bone, its ranks of translucent soldiers rising from the empty ground of Venilleth's third age. Each ghost-warrior speaks only when its summoner addresses it, and when charged they crash through foes and walls alike with force enough to fell even stone.

rites.name: Ryinnys
rites.text: Ryinnys is a conjured storm of ten thousand orphaned blades that its keeper, the Quiet Foundry of Venilleth, can call from the air over any reachable place. When the storm falls it drives shafts of steel into stone and bone alike, and the ground it leaves behind stays bristling until someone takes the time to pull each blade free.

rites.name: Alairaenwen
rites.text: Alairaenwen is a sealed mind-binding rite of the Venilleth Arcane realm, in which the speaker's palm presses upon a creature's brow and slowly draws its recollections into a silver thread of unspoken words. The victim is left with the ability to walk and speak yet no sense of who it once was, and it is free to be reshaped by whatever purpose its keeper leaves behind.

rites.name: Elinaemiel
rites.text: Elinaemiel is a volatile lattice of pulsing atomic force bound into the Venilleth Concordance as a weapon of last resort. Its wielders can call a cube of unstable energy into being, and anything caught within it has its matter unravelled until nothing is left to bury.

rites.name: Mielleth
rites.text: Mielleth is a concept of six escalating plagues: black poison, a rat swarm, stone toads, green lightning, blackened veins, and bloody locusts, summoned over ten rounds by a single caster. Its ceiling is set by the scale of a continental-level curse rather than a single battlefield.

rites.name: Oriinwen
rites.text: Oriinwen is the binding-rite of the Venilleth archivists, a bowl of ash-smoked salts that anchors a wandering soul to a place it can never leave. Its curse holds the target within a chosen radius and drags it back whenever it strays, while severing all teleportation and planar passage. Only a ninth-tier unbinding can sever the knot once it is tied.

rites.name: Ryiraenna
rites.text: Ryiraenna is a conjured pocket-realm the size of a hemisphere-sized sphere, opened through a shimmering doorway painted onto any flat stone face. Its weather, forests, and dwellings are shaped entirely by whoever sealed it, and its gate can only be found by those given its passphrase. Hidden from scrying and closed only by its maker, it keeps every soul inside it when the door fades.

rites.name: Miallys
rites.text: In the realm of Arcane, the concept of Miallys summons colossal earthen serpents, devouring all within their path, leaving behind only mounds of stone and rubble.

rites.name: Miina
rites.text: Miina is a forbidden ritual-spell of the Venilleth arcane tradition, performed by carving a ring into one's own flesh while draining the life and soul of an unconscious mortal. The caster gains lasting youth and vitality at the cost of a stolen soul that only a wish can free. Its power lies in an unholy bargain rather than raw force.

rites.name: Orieneirwen
rites.text: Orieneirwen is a silent-rite discipline of the Venilleth arcane orders, taught to apprentices who have mastered the resonance of their own voice. Its practitioners learn to still the air of a chamber so that a spell can be spoken in pure thought, at the cost of an extra measure of stored power. The art is prized in courts where whispered magic must pass unheard.

rites.name: Elannerla
rites.text: Elannerla is a resonant concept of the Arcane realm of Venilleth, a sound-weaving discipline whose practitioners learn to unsettle a foe's balance through carefully tuned tones. Its adepts can hold several enemies helpless in the same breath, and the technique is taught only after a student has mastered basic harmonic control.

rites.name: Ilyirla
rites.text: Ilyirla is an arcane sensing technique in the realm of Venilleth, where practitioners attune their minds to faint tremors and echoes until the surrounding world seems drawn in sharp relief. It lets an adept perceive nearby foes through sound alone, a skill prized by wardens of the quiet vaults of the Second Age.

rites.name: Silireimora
rites.text: Silireimora is a hushed sound-warden of Venilleth's Arcane realm, a presence that dampens the world's clamor around her as she walks. Her silence travels with her like a pale cloak, and she can call it forth without spending her reserves, though it fades after a single minute and must rest before reappearing.

rites.name: Lyerlys
rites.text: Lyerlys is a concept of resonance-craft in the Venilleth arcane tradition, where practitioners bend the voice of every working so that a spell may vanish into perfect stillness or erupt into a crushing peal. Its adepts can hush a fireball entirely or turn a cantrip into a tolling bell that rattles the bones of distant listeners. The discipline is rationed, granting only two such shapings between rests.

rites.name: Eliorlenna
rites.text: Eliorlenna is a dormant grove-spirit of the Venilleth arcane realm, woven from the sap-memory of a thousand felled and living trees across the Third Age. She is revered by the few arbormancers who hear her roots singing beneath their study-glades, and she is said to lend her strength to any working that honors the shared warmth of living timber.

rites.name: Eleimeth
rites.text: Eleimeth is a grove-sung discipline of Venilleth's Arcane realm, in which practitioners carve sigils into living timber so that their summoned companions take root as green kin. Its adepts shape bark and sap as easily as flame, and their greatest rites can split an ancient forest's heartwood with a single breath.

rites.name: Lyila
rites.text: Lyila is a concept of quiet arcane growth in Venilleth, a realm where spells are grafted onto living bark and sap-rooted sigils. Her scholars trade old formulas for green-woven ones, and each new lesson hardens a thin, protective shell around the caster for a single breath.

rites.name: Lyemeirleth
rites.text: Lyemeirleth is a concept of shared resilience in the Arcane realm of Venilleth, where a mind-bound attunement lets a warden steady the wills of companions nearby. It is a quiet, supportive gift rather than a force of destruction, drawn from the way root-networks of the old forests hold one another upright.

rites.name: Eleirluanae
rites.text: Eleirluanae is an arcane rite of the Venilleth omniverse, in which a caster gathers scraps of bark and fallen leaves across a minute of chanting and shapes them into a grove-guardian. The guardian is bound to serve the caster's company as a willing ally, and with greater mastery it can be called as a towering forest warden.

rites.name: Nuerlora
rites.text: Nuerlora is a bark-weave discipline in the Arcane realm of Venilleth, where practitioners share a living shell that hardens around their companions in the moment of decisive action. The protection lingers briefly, granting an extra measure of defense equal to the caster's reasoning acuity until the next turn ends.

rites.name: Nuillae
rites.text: Nuillae is a discipline of the Venilleth arcane orders, a martial art in which practitioners learn to bind their own resolve into the steel they carry. Adepts can channel the stored force of a warding vow through a blade or shield, turning a single defensive oath into a violent release. It is taught to frontier wardens who must hold lines against things no ordinary army could stop.

rites.name: Elaeniel
rites.text: Elaeniel is a wizard-warrior of the Venilleth Arcane, who can enter a War Form that hardens their body and steel into a force-bound fighting state lasting one minute. In this state they shrug off wounds and strike with raw force, though only briefly and only at close range.

rites.name: Lyelys
rites.text: Lyelys is a discipline of the Venilleth Arcane tradition in which a caster's cantrip becomes a kindled spark that lets a blade-strike follow hard upon it. Practitioners of the Arcane Age of E6 learn to fold the flicker of a minor spell into a second, swifter stroke.

rites.name: Siliorleth
rites.text: Siliorleth is a discipline of duellists in Venilleth who weave a sustained sorcerous working into their every strike, so that the lattice of the spell lends its focus to the blade. Its practitioners are feared for turning a single held enchantment into a second, cutting edge.

rites.name: Venillora
rites.text: Venillora is a crystalline sovereign-forge that hums beneath the Venilleth mantle, a concept-level being born in the third age of the Arcane realm. Its Ashen Choir channels stored storm-glass into those who bond with it, sharpening their blades and wardings alike.

rites.name: Lyimenora
rites.text: Lyimenora is a concept of an arcane sharpshooter's focus, a bonded ranged implement that channels thought into shot, shaped by the Venilleth arcane tradition of E6. Its bearer may swap the bonded piece over a long rest, and it can be a conduit for spellcraft. The concept's energy is set at a planetary scale of impact.

rites.name: Veneilana
rites.text: Veneilana is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Venilleth omniverse, a discipline that lets a gunsmith's tuned focus carry spell-force across distances once thought impossible. Its practitioners in the fourth age of the sixth era learn to stretch the reach of their charges along the lines of a firearm's sighting.

rites.name: Ryeriolae
rites.text: Ryeriolae is a sealed-chamber resonance engine, a brass-and-glass lattice that hums in the dark between the tides of Venilleth's moons. Its keeper tunes it with pale copper filaments, and when the lattice reaches a certain pitch, the whole instrument can split a single spark into a fan of shimmering echoes.

rites.name: Lyirlaneth
rites.text: Lyirlaneth is a concept of layered sorcery from the Arcane realm of Venilleth, a mode of channeling in which a practitioner binds two distinct enchantments into a single focus at once. Within the fourth age of the E6 era, its adepts are said to hold a crystallizing dual-flame that can be shaped and loosed as one. The concept is taught as a mark of advanced mastery over arcane vessels.

rites.name: Oriarliel
rites.text: Oriarliel is a concept, an arcane sigil-engine sealed inside the glass spires of Venilleth during its fourth age. Its signature act is to mark a target with a fading lattice of light so that the next channeled bolt strikes with a bloom of added force.

rites.name: Venilwen
rites.text: Venilwen is a sky-listening concept of the Arcane realm in Venilleth, a discipline in which practitioners tune their wills to the slow turning of distant lights. Its adepts read the drift of heavenly bodies to foretell tides, storms, and the fortunes of those who sleep beneath them.

rites.name: Venaerwen
rites.text: Venaerwen is a concept of starlight-reading in the Venilleth omniverse, an age-seven scholar who learned to speak and write the language of the heavens. Those who study under this current can navigate by distant stars and summon drifting lanterns of light at will.

rites.name: Alaanna
rites.text: Alaanna is a concept in Venilleth's Arcane realm, the starlight that answers a caster's call and lingers on those marked by it. Its marks blaze like a faerie fire that outlasts the moment of the spell. It is kept in the E6 era, where the quiet light of the night sky is a daily presence rather than a force of ruin.

rites.name: Elaenioma
rites.text: Elaenioma is a concept of celestial mimicry, a discipline in which a practitioner borrows the steadiness of distant suns, moons, stars, and worlds to shape their body for a single day's vigil. Each dawn of rest lets the bearer choose one borrowed heaven, which holds until the next awakening.

rites.name: Venioneth
rites.text: Venioneth is a arcane conduit-art in the realm of Venilleth, where a caster links allies and foes into a luminous web of sorcery. Each strike chains onward through a sequence of targets, and a successful linking restores a fraction of the spent magic. Its power is measured in the reach of the chain rather than raw force.

rites.name: Ryelora
rites.text: Ryelora is an Arcane-realm concept in the Venilleth omniverse, a discipline of seers who read the hidden grammar of enchantments. Practitioners of the Ryelora art can sense the latent structure of working magic and unravel it before it completes. Their keenest insight is treated as a sacred inheritance, passed down through the orders of the Seventh Era.

rites.name: Mienwen
rites.text: Mienwen is a tradition of mimic-scholars in Venilleth who snatch the workings of passing sorcery and hold them only briefly before they fade. Their practitioners can echo a rival's conjuration within moments of witnessing it, though the borrowed craft slips from memory by the next rest.
